component.name: ZenFile
component.summary: A modern, GPU-accelerated cross-platform file manager

description.p: ZenFile is a modern, high-performance, GPU-accelerated file manager built using the Zenthra framework. It features rich animations, virtualized item views, robust file preview capabilities, and fluid navigation.

ul.li: GPU-accelerated vector UI for sub-pixel text rendering and smooth transitions.
Highly optimized virtualized lists and grids.
Customizable color themes and design aesthetics.
Fully self-contained packaging for extreme portability.
